6d_atb_2t.title: 6D ATB-2T
6d_atb_2t.rider_takeaway: A competition-grade dirt helmet built to keep riders cool under physical exertion and shielded from roost and track debris.
pros: Extra-wide eyeport with molded non-slip goggle strap stabilization channels
Featherweight 1346g shell construction significantly minimizes neck fatigue during long rides
Aerospace-grade 100% carbon fiber shell delivers elite kinetic energy dispersion at minimal weight
Dual DOT & ECE 22.05 certified for verified road and highway safety
cons: High cockpit wind turbulence (~100 dB at 100 km/h); hearing protection / earplugs strongly advised
Requires separate riding goggles; unsealed eyeport offers no protection against highway rain and cold

pros: Direct airflow across the face provides superior natural cooling in warm weather
Featherweight 1306g shell construction significantly minimizes neck fatigue during long rides
Durable impact-resistant polycarbonate shell delivers reliable protection at an accessible price point
Dual DOT & ECE 22.05 certified for verified road and highway safety
cons: High cockpit wind turbulence (~98 dB at 100 km/h); hearing protection / earplugs strongly advised
Open-face design lacks chin bar protection, leaving the lower facial zone exposed in an impact
